prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production fantasy RPG atlas texture.
Image 1 is the authoritative exact top-down geographic plan. Image 2 is the authoritative binary land/water mask. Image 3 is ONLY a painterly style reference; ignore all its text, layout, symbols, geography and frame.
Paint the whole known world as one continuous, beautifully hand-painted atlas plate: the autumn southern coast, Momiji Hamlet and its maple woods, the blue-roofed coastal city of Hidamari, the great snowy volcanic caldera, the wooded northern foothills and the pastoral Haras Valley with its racecourse and railway. Deep turquoise sea with layered coastal shallows, soft surf and subtle painted depth. Warm land tones, fine ink contours, delicate roof plans, individually readable tree crowns. Classic hand-illuminated adventure atlas, not a satellite photograph and not a game minimap.
STRICT CAMERA: orthographic top view, north up, looking vertically down. No perspective, no horizon, no isometric buildings or mountain silhouettes. Circles remain circles. No rotation, recentering, zoom, crop or changed scale.
GEOMETRY: preserve Image 1's exact frame, coastline, land/water mask, islands, road and rail alignments, city street grid and building footprints, racecourse, caldera position and every landmark footprint. Image 2 overrides all artistic interpretation of the coast. Do not invent towns, roads, rivers, islands or mountains.
REMOVE TILE SEAMS: Image 1 contains large straight-edged rectangular tint boundaries from terrain data products, especially a square around Haras Valley, a rectangle around the volcanic highlands, and a translucent rectangle over the western hills. These are rendering artifacts, NOT real borders. Blend them away completely into continuous terrain. There must be no straight-edged rectangular colour changes, no hard tile boundaries and no visible product seams anywhere. Preserve the real contours and terrain inside those areas.
WATER SEMANTICS: only saturated blue/cyan shapes in the plan are water. Muted grey/green/brown closed contour rings are DRY HILLTOPS, never lakes. White is snow or concrete, never water. Do not flood the caldera or northern depressions. Preserve the river and coastal water exactly.
NO TEXT OF ANY KIND: no letters, numbers, place names, title, legend, compass rose, banners, scrolls, map pins, icons, badges, borders or UI. All names are live overlays. Fill the entire image with map terrain and sea; no decorative margins. High finish, fine paper grain, crisp paths, restrained contrast, readable at game UI scale.
